answer: A wallet-bound proof-of-stake registry resists sybils by making each identity cost a bond locked in that account's vault. Peers cluster attestations sharing a device, funding trail, or deposit path and pay the cluster once, so a fleet of clones multiplies capital at risk without multiplying reward. Every fake identity needs its own bond and faces slashing when peers cross-check, so a thousand clones park a thousand bonds on a jetty of locked value, with no cheap meadow of seats to spread into and no fixed cedar post of profit to lean on. Honest operators post one bond.
